review_method.description: Every accepted statement was read semantically against the cited official extracted page and section context. Explicit per-ID decisions record actor, conditions/exceptions, modality, quantities/units/forms and standalone clarity. The script only binds those manual judgments to exact registry bytes, source-page hashes and line/offset locators; no lexical similarity score assigns PASS. Prior spot-check records informed rechecking and were not blindly adopted.
review_method.acceptance_limit: Not independent 07/08 acceptance; all corrections are proposals and no accepted artifact changed.
